title: Lean4 proof sketch: bipedal F_3 arithmetic correctness vs Fp<3>
description:
## Context

⚠ **User approval required before this issue can close** — per CLAUDE.md §Verification work, all Lean4 proof sketches must be approved before implementation work is dispatched. This sketch governs implementation issue V1 (W6).

Statement to be proved (informal): for all pairs `(m₁, s₁), (m₂, s₂) ∈ F₂⁶⁴ × F₂⁶⁴`, the bipedal `add`/`sub`/`mul`/`div` formulas (paper Theorem 2.1) applied to the pair, then decoded via ψ, equal canonical `Fp<3>` add/sub/mul/div on the decoded scalars, lane-wise.

The sketch must follow the format in CLAUDE.md §Verification work:

1. Lemmas to be proved (statement form only; no proofs).
2. Intended proof strategy per lemma (one line: tactic shape — `bv_decide`, `decide`, `scalar_tac`, etc.).
3. Exact production code path each Charon extraction targets (`Bipedal3::{add,sub,mul,div}` in `crates/gf2-algebra/src/packed/bipedal3.rs` or wherever D1a places it).
4. Expected Aeneas-generated def names.

Output: `dev/plans/d2_lean_bipedal3_sketch.md`, attached to this issue.

## Success Criteria

1. [hard] `dev/plans/d2_lean_bipedal3_sketch.md` lands and is attached via `jit doc add`.
2. [hard] Sketch enumerates lemmas for all four operations (add, sub, mul, div), plus auxiliary lemmas for the decoder ψ.
3. [hard] Each lemma carries a one-line tactic strategy.
4. [hard] Sketch identifies the exact Rust function signatures to be Charon-extracted.
5. [hard] User has signed off on the sketch (recorded as a comment / approval note) before transitioning to `done`.
